Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Normal hearing  [AND] and vision
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Left-handedness
  -  History of seizure, head injury (including neurosurgery), brain injury, diagnosis or a neurological  [OR] or psychiatric disorder, [OR]  metal in the head, [OR]  sensitive scalp
  -  History of anxiolytic  [OR] and/or antidepressant medications
  -  Participation in Experiment  [OR] #1 or Experiment #2 of the larger study
